description.narrative:
Protection needs of refugees and asylum seekers through the provision of protection, life-saving assistance, using a community-based approach (Warrap and Northern Bahr El Ghazal). The project will focus on unaccompanied and separated children as a result of forced displacements/refugee setting.
Outcome 1 (OA4 - GBV): National authorities and communities are able to strengthen gender equality and respond to/prevent GBV - Community based GBV response, mitigation and prevention mechanisms supported for refugees and asylum seekers.(Makpandu Refugee Camp, Wau and Aweil)
Outcome 2 (OA5 - Children): Youth and children are well integrated into their communities and able to assume effective roles in them. - Community based child protection mechanisms supported (Makpandu Refugee Camp, and Aweil) - Best interest determination supported (Makpandu Refugee Camp)
Outcome 3 (OA6 - Justice): Persons of concern have improved access to justice by 2025. - Legal counselling, assistance and interventions in favour of POCs are supported (Makpandu Refugee Camp) - The safety of refugees and asylum seekers is monitored (Wau) - Access and legal protection monitored (Aweil)
Outcome 4 (OA7 - Community): Communities adopt structures and practices for the improvement of self-reliance and freedom of choice. - Community self-management structures supported (Makpandu Refugee Camp) - Peaceful coexistance and self-reliance projects between host communities and persons of concern are supported (Makpandu Refugee Camp, Wau and Aweil)
Outcome 5 (OA9 - Housing): By 2025, persons of concern have access to sustainable shelter solutions - Climate sensitive resource management improved (Makpandu Refugee Camp) - Shelter support is provided for refugees and asylum seekers (Makpandu Refugee Camp, Wau and Aweil)
Outcome 6 (OA10 - Health): Persons of concern have improved access to healthcare by 2025. - Access to health services enhanced (Makpandu Refugee Camp, Wau and Aweil) - HIV & AIDS treatment for PoCs supported (Makpandu Refugee Camp and Aweil) - Community management of acute malnutrition supported (Makpandu Refugee Camp) - Support to safe motherhood services provided (Makpandu Refugee Camp) - Infant and young child feeding practices supported (Makpandu Refugee Camp)
Outcome 7 (OA11 - Education): By 2025, children and youth have enhanced access to education opportunities - Enrolment in education is supported (Makpandu Refugee Camp, Wau and Aweil)
Outcome 8 (OA12 - WASH): Persons of concern have improved access to clean and safe water, sanitation and hygiene facilities by 2025 - Hygiene promotion is supported for refugees and asylum seekers (Makpandu Refugee Camp) - Water and sanitation services provided for refugees and asylum seekers (Makpandu Refugee Camp)
Outcome 9 (OA13 - Livelihood): The majority of persons of concern gain access to sustainable livelihoods by 2025. - PoC livelihoods supported (Makpandu Refugee Camp, and Aweil)
Outcome 10 (OA16 - Integrate): - Solutions for PoCs supported (Gangura, Sakure, Ezo, Tambura, Greater Mundri, Maridi, Ibba, Source Yubu)
Outcome 11 (OA8 - well-being): - Refugees and asylum seekers with specific needs supported (Makpandu Refugee Camp, and Aweil)
